description: This file contains CUDA/C++ source code implementing various linear algebra functions leveraging cuBLAS, cuSOLVER, ROCsolver, and other GPU libraries for PyTorch's ATen native CUDA backend. It includes functions for SVD, Cholesky decomposition, eigenvalue computations, QR factorizations, and related utilities, with support for batch operations and multiple GPU backends.
